answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 47 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The summit register is checked at draw time, ember lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 47 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The deposit is 70 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
